home.headline: Bays Horizon is building the autonomous vFarm in public.
home.subhead: We are wiring a real vertical farm to an AI engine that learns from every harvest. Join Early Access to see the builds, system diagrams, and monthly progress as we move toward a fully automated vFarm twin.
home.meta_description: We are wiring a real vertical farm to an AI engine that learns from every harvest. Join Early Access to see the builds, system diagrams, and monthly progress.

early_access.headline: Join vFarm Founding Buyer Early Access
early_access.body: Receive build-progress updates, get priority consideration for future cabinet availability, and help shape crop and feature priorities.
early_access.qualifier: This is an expression of interest—not a purchase, paid subscription, hardware reservation, delivery commitment, or SLA.
early_access.success_message: You're on the list. We'll send build updates as the flagship comes together.
early_access.error_message: That didn't go through. Try again, or email hello@bhanetwork.org.

supporting_claims: vFarm is being developed as an enclosed, pesticide-free growing system.
Continuous environmental monitoring and digital-twin updates are part of the current product direction.
Verified build, CAD, render, configuration and monitoring progress may be shown with its real status.
Early participants may receive priority consideration and preferential pricing treatment, but exact benefits remain subject to final SPEC, BOM, production pricing and commercial approval.

what_vfarm_is.title: A vertical farm rig sized for a spare room.
what_vfarm_is.body: Four tiers, roughly the footprint of a bookshelf.

what_vfarm_is.title: Base vFarm: frame, trays, lights, pumps.
what_vfarm_is.body: Everything the rig needs to grow without a laptop attached.

what_vfarm_is.title: Monitoring that reports what it did.
what_vfarm_is.body: pH, temperature, flow. It says when something needs you.

what_vfarm_is.title: One flagship rig running unattended by 31 Oct.
what_vfarm_is.body: Twenty-four hours, no hands. That is the bar.

build_feed.title: Tray three fits with 4mm to spare
build_feed.body: The v2 frame went in the bin. This is the third print of the same bracket, and the first one that clears the light bar.

build_feed.title: First strawberry
build_feed.body: Eleven weeks from seed. One berry.

build_feed.title: The system learned something
build_feed.body: It broke at 3am and fixed itself by 3:04.

build_feed.title: Real install
build_feed.body: The rig going into a real room.
